name: Ecosurety Packaging EPR Analytics
description: UK packaging EPR compliance for Ecosurety members: packaging placed on market, RAM recyclability, modulated EPR fees, PRN obligations and costs, and data validation. One row per packaging data line, daily from Oct 2024 to Oct 2026.

columns.name: Record ID
columns.desc: Unique packaging data line (one SKU component placed on the UK market).

columns.name: Placed on Market Date
columns.desc: Date the packaging was supplied / placed on the UK market.

columns.name: Producer
columns.desc: Ecosurety member brand obligated under UK packaging EPR.

columns.name: Sector
columns.desc: Producer sector, e.g. Food & Drink, Health & Beauty, Grocery Retail.

columns.name: Producer Size
columns.desc: Large or small producer under pEPR thresholds.

columns.name: Producer Nation
columns.desc: UK nation of the producer's registered office.

columns.name: Producer Region
columns.desc: UK region of the producer's registered office.

columns.name: Material
columns.desc: Packaging material: Plastic, Paper and Card, Glass, Aluminium, Steel, Wood, Fibre-based Composite, Other.

columns.name: Packaging Format
columns.desc: Packaging format, e.g. Bottle, Flexible Film, Corrugated Box, Can.

columns.name: Packaging Type
columns.desc: pEPR packaging type: Household, Non-household, Public Bin, Household Drinks Container.

columns.name: Packaging Class
columns.desc: Primary, secondary or shipment packaging.

columns.name: Nation of Sale
columns.desc: UK nation the packaging was sold into (nation of sale requirement).

columns.name: Supplier
columns.desc: Packaging supplier that provided the component data.

columns.name: RAM Rating
columns.desc: Recyclability Assessment Methodology rating: Red, Amber or Green; drives fee modulation.

columns.name: Data Issue
columns.desc: Validation issue found by Ecosurety's automated checks, or None.

columns.name: Submission ID
columns.desc: Monthly producer data submission the line belongs to.

columns.name: Submission Date
columns.desc: Date the producer submitted the month's data.

columns.name: Submission Status
columns.desc: Data Collection, In Validation, Validated, Submitted to Regulator, Resubmission Required.

columns.name: Issue Status
columns.desc: Open, Resolved or No Issue.

columns.name: Units Placed
columns.desc: Packaging units placed on the market.

columns.name: Tonnage
columns.desc: Packaging weight placed on the market, tonnes.

columns.name: Red-rated Tonnage
columns.desc: Tonnes of packaging rated Red under RAM.

columns.name: Recycled Content %
columns.desc: Average recycled content of the packaging, percent.

columns.name: Base Fee per Tonne
columns.desc: pEPR base waste-management fee per tonne for the material (household and public bin packaging).

columns.name: EPR Fee
columns.desc: Modulated pEPR waste-management fee (Red x1.2, Amber x1.0, Green x0.9).

columns.name: PRN Obligation
columns.desc: Recycling evidence (PRN/PERN) obligation in tonnes.

columns.name: PRN Price
columns.desc: Average PRN/PERN price paid per tonne.

columns.name: PRN Cost
columns.desc: Cost of recycling evidence (PRNs/PERNs) bought to meet the obligation.

columns.name: Checks Failed
columns.desc: Automated validation checks failed by the line.

columns.name: Days Open
columns.desc: Days an open data issue has been outstanding.

columns.name: Data Issues
columns.desc: Lines with at least one validation issue.

columns.name: Open Issues
columns.desc: Lines with an open validation issue.

columns.name: Data Lines
columns.desc: Packaging data lines.

formulas.name: Red-rated Share
formulas.desc: Share of tonnage rated Red under RAM.

formulas.name: EPR Fee per Tonne
formulas.desc: Modulated EPR fee per tonne of packaging.

formulas.name: PRN Cost per Tonne
formulas.desc: Weighted PRN price per tonne of obligation.

formulas.name: Data Issue Rate
formulas.desc: Share of data lines with a validation issue.
